value.name: Asha pauses at the doorway
value.description: Asha stops at the threshold, steadies herself with the doorframe, and takes a slow breath before entering the room.
evidence: At the threshold Asha stopped, one hand resting briefly on the doorframe, and drew a breath that she let out slowly through her nose before she stepped inside.

value.name: Rosa follows cautiously
value.description: Rosa enters behind Asha at a measured pace and glances back toward the hallway where the briefcase remains.
evidence: Rosa came in behind her at the same measured pace she kept in any hallway at any hour, her eyes flicking back once down the corridor to where the briefcase still leaned against the wainscoting, then settling on Asha's shoulders again.

value.name: Asha surveys the bedside objects
value.description: Asha studies the chair, cardigan, and water glass by the bed before finally looking at her mother.
evidence: Asha did not look at the bed yet; she looked at the chair beside it, at the folded cardigan on its arm, at a water glass with a straw bent toward where a head would be.
Only then, with Rosa a careful step behind her, did she let her gaze travel to her mother, and she made herself keep it there.

value.name: Asha sits beside her mother
value.description: Asha crosses to the bed and lowers herself onto the chair beside it, brushing against the folded cardigan.
evidence: Asha crossed the short distance to the bed in three quiet steps and lowered herself to the edge of the chair so that the folded cardigan brushed her sleeve.

value.name: Asha takes her mother's hand
value.description: Asha reaches for her mother's hand and is struck by its warmth and familiarity.
evidence: She let her hand find her mother's where it lay on top of the blanket, the skin warmer than she had braced for, the knuckles familiar in a way that almost undid her

value.name: Asha asks if her mother recognizes her
value.description: Asha quietly asks her mother whether she knows who she is.
evidence: and she asked, low enough that only the room would hear it, whether her mother knew who she was.

value.name: Mother studies Asha silently
value.description: Asha's mother does not answer immediately and instead searches Asha's face with slow, uncertain attention.
evidence: The answer did not come right away; her mother's eyes moved over her face with the slow, searching attention of someone reading a page in poor light.

value.name: Rosa holds back at the doorway
value.description: Rosa remains in the doorway, watching Asha closely and keeping her distance.
evidence: From the doorway Rosa held her step back, taking in the line of Asha's shoulders
